body_html:
h/t @nehassaiuactor
"DuBois and Ellison watch:
The phone. A cop’s loaded gun.

A cop’s loaded gun. Her phone…
“Yes, he’s black.” Her tears are black.

“Yes, he’s black.” Her tears are black.
Aren’t all our heroine’s brothers?

DuBois’s and Ellison’s march."
#quote
